Definition: of Latin origin; Neron (i.e. Nero), a Roman emperor:--Nero.
BiblicalUsage: Nero never appears by name anywhere in the Greek New Testament. The emperor who ruled when Paul wrote and when the church was persecuted is never named in the text itself, and no verse carries this word.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe that silence is worth noting: the gospel was written for the age of Nero, yet the text never gives him the honour of a name.
